To avoid this, be sure to clear all transient storage at the end of any call to your contract. The use of transient storage for reentrancy guards that are cleared at the end of the call is safe.

errors.message: Transient storage as defined by EIP-1153 can break the composability of smart contracts: Since transient storage is cleared only at the end of the transaction and not at the end of the outermost call frame to the contract within a transaction, your contract may unintentionally misbehave when invoked multiple times in a complex transaction. To avoid this, be sure to clear all transient storage at the end of any call to your contract. The use of transient storage for reentrancy guards that are cleared at the end of the call is safe.

documentation.text:
@title GiwaCLDeployer
 @notice Dedicated deployer contract for Concentrated Liquidity Pools (CLAMM)

@title GiwaCLPool
 @notice Production Concentrated Liquidity AMM Pool on Giwa Chain with Cancun transient storage reentrancy protection.

@title GiwaPoolFactory
 @notice Core Factory contract for deploying Concentrated Liquidity (CLAMM) and Stableswap pools on Giwa Chain.

@title GiwaStableDeployer
 @notice Dedicated deployer contract for Stableswap Curve Invariant Pools

@title GiwaStablePool
 @notice Stableswap pool implementing the Curve-style invariant for ultra-low slippage swaps between pegged assets.

@title DeployGiwaDEX
 @notice Production Deployment Script for Giwa DEX Protocol on Giwa Sepolia (Chain ID: 91342).

@title EmergencyGuardian
 @notice Multi-Sig circuit breaker contract allowing granular pool pause and emergency stop without freezing the entire protocol.

@title GiwaTimelockController
 @notice 48-hour Timelock controller enforcing execution delay on administrative and fee adjustments.

@title IGiwaCLPool
 @notice Interface for Giwa Concentrated Liquidity AMM Pools (CLAMM).

@title IGiwaFactory
 @notice Interface for Giwa DEX Factory contract managing pool deployments and fee configurations.

@title IGiwaPool
 @notice Interface for Giwa DEX liquidity pools supporting dynamic fee tiers and Flashblocks optimization.

@title IGiwaCLDeployer
 @notice Deployer interface for Concentrated Liquidity Pools

@title IGiwaStableDeployer
 @notice Deployer interface for Stableswap Invariant Pools

@title IGiwaPoolFactory
 @notice Comprehensive Factory Interface for Giwa DEX deploying Concentrated Liquidity and Stableswap Pools.

@title IGiwaStablePool
 @notice Interface for Stableswap pools utilizing amplification coefficient (A) for ultra-low slippage pegged swaps.

@title IGiwaUniversalRouter
 @notice Single entry point for routing swaps across Concentrated Liquidity (CLAMM) and Stableswap pools.

@title IProtocolFeeVault
 @notice Interface for the Protocol Fee Splitter (70% LPs, 20% POL Treasury, 10% Buyback/Burn).

@title SafeCast
 @notice Contains methods for safely casting between different numeric primitive types.

@title SqrtPriceMath
 @notice Computes token amounts from changes in sqrt price and vice versa for concentrated liquidity.

@title SwapMath
 @notice Computes the result of a swap step given price, target price, available liquidity, and remaining amount.

@title TickBitmap
 @notice Stores a packed mapping of tick index to its initialized state.

@title TickMath
 @notice Computes sqrt price for ticks of size 1.0001, i.e., sqrt(1.0001^tick) as a Q64.96 number. Supports ticks between -887272 and 887272.

@title GiwaUniversalRouter
 @notice Universal Router for Giwa Chain aggregating swaps across Concentrated Liquidity and Stableswap pools.
